name: find_connections
description: Find previously recorded explicit transitions (connections) between locations. Use before creating a connection that might already exist, and when the master must recall secret tunnels, portals, or other canon links. An empty result means no such connection was recorded — not that travel is impossible. Ordinary hierarchy adjacency is not returned here.

location_id.description: Optional location ID that must appear as either endpoint. When set, from_id/to_id direction flags are ignored.

either_direction.description: When from_id and to_id are both set, also return the reverse directed row (to_id -> from_id).

include_bidirectional_reverse.description: When from_id and to_id are both set (and either_direction is false), also return reverse rows marked bidirectional.
